استحيثوا (form X)
# اُسْتُحِيثُوا (ustuḥīṯū) /us.tu.ħiː.θuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحَاثَ (istaḥāṯa)
# اِسْتَحِيثُوا (istaḥīṯū) /is.ta.ħiː.θuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحَاثَ (istaḥāṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
